newsitem.title: UK: Sinn Fein leaders feature in IRA video - paper.
newsitem.headline: Sinn Fein leaders feature in IRA video - paper.

text.p: Sinn Fein president Gerry Adams and the party's top strategist Martin McGuinness feature in a new propaganda video for the Irish Republican Army, a British newspaper said on Monday.

"The two men, who have consistenly denied that they are IRA leaders, appear on the 55-minute video sandwiched between lengthy shots of masked terrorists firing automatic rifles and mortar bombs," The Times said.
In one shot Adams is shown giving a clenched fist at a republican rally in Belfast and both men are quoted blaming Britain for the collapse of a 17-month IRA ceasefire last February.
Former Northern Ireland minister Michael Mates said the video, "The IRA In Our Streets and In Our Countryside," showed that the two men were IRA leaders.
"It puts in black and white what we have known all along. There is no difference between Sinn Fein and the IRA. They are a seamless robe," he told the newspaper.
But a Sinn Fein spokesman said it did not prove anything. "There is nothing sinister in a clenched fist salute at a rally," he said.
Sinn Fein has been barred from Northern Ireland peace talks until the IRA reinstates it ceasefire.
